name: PYROCAST database
size_as_stated: 148 PyroCb events linked to 111 wildfires between 2018 and 2022, equivalent to over 18 thousand hourly observations; cropped to 200 by 200-pixel images

scales.note: Cropped 200x200 pixel scenes at 1 km resolution with hourly temporal sampling across 2018-2022 (5 years); ~18,000 hourly observations with 25 satellite and ERA5 channels.
